Name: Build More Greenhouses
Author: Celestia87
Description:
This Mod allows you to build Greenhouses on your farm using Robins build menus.
by default if you don't have greenhouse unlocked it will not show up in build menu you can enable in the mod configuration

Will use Default greenhouse textures so any greenhouse texture replacement mod should update the new Greenhouses as well and any mod expanding the inside will also update the new greenhouses.

Using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url] mod will allow price, build time, and cost changes, for these to take effect you must configure and wait one in game time cycle (10 in game min) before going back into robins while playing.  


 “ Other Mod Warning “

Custom warp points in modded greenhouses will always warp you back to default/original greenhouse. This is caused by newly built greenhouses getting a custom in game identification. So warp tags referring to greenhouse default to main greenhouse.

Downloads.Description: Fixed and Verified for Stardew Valley 1.6.9 - Smapi 4.1.1
